name: penwright
description: Typst document editor — let Claude Desktop drive your Penwright projects.
long_description: Penwright is a project-first WYSIWYG editor for Typst documents. This extension exposes typed tools that let Claude open and edit your projects, manage chapters and bibliography, drive the structured design surface (themes / palettes / layouts / design elements / per-chapter looks), render a page so it can SEE the layout, search across files, save versions, undo its own edits, and export to PDF / DOCX. Design changes are test-compiled and rolled back if they would break the document. All Typst compilation runs through the bundled Typst binary, packages, and OFL fonts — no external dependencies, fully offline.
